caption: the amnesiac ninja's sandbox - three warlords, contract jobs and acquire's honest stealth law.
about: Shinobido: way of the ninja (2005) is acquire's follow-up to tenchu's stealth law: an amnesiac ninja sells contract work to three feuding warlords, and every mission is a sandbox of rooftops, guards and honest line-of-sight stealth. The mission editor and the loyalty economy gave it replay depth the genre still rarely matches.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
